result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I ran the tests matching `*SalesRep*` and they passed. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, so your Anna/Bob example hasn't been run.

The change is in `countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` in `DataStore.java`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, the same filter the other per-rep counts use. I also added a line about it to the method's Javadoc. Reps with no purchase orders in the period still appear with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.
